name: 50111 · Grimes, IA
findings: ZIP 50111 (Grimes) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50111 (Grimes) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
64% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50111 (Grimes) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
